# Vanilla Roguelike

> A turn-based terminal roguelike in plain Ruby, built on an Entity-Component-System with an event system and seeded, replayable runs. Companion code to the book "Building Your Own Roguelike: A Practical Guide". MIT licensed.

Run with `./bin/play.rb`. Test with `bundle exec rspec`; lint with `bundle exec rubocop`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, quickstart, keys, doc map
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, run, first change
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): ECS, game loop, system order, design rationale, known limits
- [How-to](docs/how-to.md): add a component, system, command or event; re-record tapes; logs
- [Events](docs/events.md): every event type and its data
- [Coding practices](docs/coding-practices.md): method order and Ruby conventions

## Code entry points

- [bin/play.rb](bin/play.rb): CLI entry point and options
- [lib/vanilla/game.rb](lib/vanilla/game.rb): world setup, system registration, game loop
- [lib/vanilla/world.rb](lib/vanilla/world.rb): ECS coordinator
- [lib/vanilla/events/types.rb](lib/vanilla/events/types.rb): event type registry
- [spec/support/headless_game.rb](spec/support/headless_game.rb): drives the real game without a terminal
